results.title: Road signs not for adverts or political campaigns – NRSA warns
results.content: The National Road Safety Authority (NRSA) has cautioned businesses, religious organisations and political parties against using road signs and other road infrastructure for advertising, publicity and campaign activities, warning that the practice poses serious risks to road safety.

results.title: Early BECE registration fuels examination malpractice – Africa Education Watch
results.content: The Executive Director of Africa Education Watch, Kofi Asare, has defended the Education Minister’s directive restricting the premature registration of candidates for the Basic Education Certificate Examination (BECE), arguing that the practice undermines the integrity of the national assessment system.

results.title: Ghana loses $1.9bn yearly to air pollution, Clean Air Fund warns
results.content: Ghana faces an estimated $1.9 billion in annual economic costs from ambient air pollution, the Country Lead for the Clean Air Fund, Desmond Appiah, has disclosed, calling for the issue to receive greater attention under the government's healthcare interventions.

results.title: GEA pushes for financial discipline among women-led businesses
results.content: The Ghana Enterprises Agency (GEA) has urged women entrepreneurs, particularly market traders and small business owners, to adopt sound financial management practices, including separating personal finances from business transactions, keeping proper records and opening dedicated business bank accounts to strengthen their enterprises.

results.content: From a modest trading operation in 1995 to a diversified business conglomerate employing more than 2,000 Ghanaians, CAITEC Group has marked three decades of remarkable growth and investment across strategic sectors of the economy.

results.content: Ghana has launched a National Referral Mechanism (NRM) to strengthen the protection, safe return and sustainable reintegration of migrants in vulnerable situations.

results.title: Okaikwei North MCE suspends personal aide over alleged assault on an Assembly staff member

results.title: Treat women-led businesses as market opportunities, not CSR initiatives – BoG Research Director urges banks
results.content: The Director of the Research Department at the Bank of Ghana (BoG), Philip Abradu-Otoo, has urged banks to treat women-led businesses as a viable market segment rather than a corporate social responsibility initiative, calling for financial products that reflect their business realities and credit needs.

results.title: BoG working with partners to reduce lending risks for women-led businesses – Director of Research
results.content: The Bank of Ghana (BoG) is working with partners to reduce the risks associated with lending to women-led businesses as part of efforts to improve their access to credit and ensure that financial inclusion translates into meaningful economic opportunities, the Director of the Research Department, Philip Abradu-Otoo, has said.

results.title: Awula Serwah calls for urgent action to stop pollution of water bodies
results.content: The Executive Director of Eco-Conscious Citizens, Awual Serwah, has called for urgent action to end the continued pollution of Ghana's water bodies, warning that the success of the country's water restoration efforts will depend on the effective enforcement of existing environmental laws.

results.title: Guinea-Bissau’s military leaders delay return to civilian rule until 2028
